title: gen-eval CLI contract
description: Contract for a tool descriptor's invocation surface. Ground truth for deriving a ToolDescriptor (design D1, D5). OpenAPI is deliberately not reused: a tool's flags are process configuration rather than operation parameters, and OpenAPI cannot express exit codes.

contract_version.description: Bumped on any breaking change to this contract's shape.

executable.description: Console-script name resolved from PATH. This is the published artifact, not a source module path.

commands.description: Invocation units. A flat flag-only CLI declares exactly one command with an empty name; its flags are the coverage units.

exit_codes.description: Documented process exit codes. OpenAPI has no equivalent, which is the primary reason this schema exists separately.

name.description: Subcommand path, space-separated (e.g. 'lock acquire'). Empty string for a flat CLI with no subcommands.

operation_id.description: Links this command to an OpenAPI operation when the CLI is a client of a contracted service. Absent for tool-only surfaces such as gen-eval's own CLI.

repeatable.description: Array parameters bind to repeated flags rather than a delimited value.

short_circuits.description: Flag exits before required-argument enforcement (the --help / --version / --print-contract-version class). Derivation must not mark such a flag as requiring other flags.

binds_to.description: How this flag maps onto an OpenAPI operation parameter. Absent for surface-local concerns such as --output-dir or --verbose.

binding.description: The binding spec named in design D1's cons: an operation's (path, query, body) does not map mechanically onto argv.

parameter.description: Parameter name in the OpenAPI operation, or JSON pointer into the request body.

sysexits_name.description: BSD sysexits.h constant when applicable (e.g. EX_USAGE for 64).
